g.aa.aa.html: ז, Zâyin, seventh letter; used as numeral 7 in modern Heb.; no evidence of this usage in OT times.

g.ab.aa.html: זאב (√ of foll.; acc. to Fl Bericht d. sächs G. d. w. i. (1846–47) 430f. = Kleinere Schriften iii. 221f. i.q. Ar. Arabic drive away and despise, drive or frighten away, whence Arabic, Arabic, זְאֵב wolf, as driven or chased away; cf. Hom NS 304 MV al.)

g.ab.ac.html: זְאֵב n.pr.m. (wolf)—a prince of Midian; also in n.pr.loc. wine-vat of Zeeb.

g.ac.aa.html: זבב (√ of foll.; cf. Ar. Arabic go hither and thither (of a man); Arabic make to dangle, or move to and fro, of a thing suspended in the air; but in this sense perhaps denom.)

g.ac.ab.html: זְבוּב n.m. fly (as moving to and fro in the air?);—lit. only Ec 10:1 i.e. dead flies

g.ad.aa.html: [זָבַד] vb. bestow upon, endow with, Gn 30:20a

g.ad.ab.html: זֶ֫בֶד n.m. endowment, gift, Gn 30:20a cf. foregoing [g.ad.aa].

g.ad.ac.html:
זָבָד n.pr.m. (he hath given, or, a gift)
1 a descendant of Judah
2 an Ephraimite
3 one of David’s valiant men
4 one of the murderers of Joash of Judah
5 name of three returned exiles who had taken strange wives

g.ad.ad.html: זָבוּד n.pr.m. (bestowed) an officer of Solomon 1 K 4:5.

g.ad.ae.html: זבוד n.pr.m. a returned exile Ezr 8:14 Kt; Qr זַכּוּר, q.v.

g.ad.af.html: זבידה Kt, זְבוּדָה Qr, n.pr.f. mother of Jehoiakim

g.ad.ag.html:
זַבְדִּי n.pr.m.
1 grandfather of Achan, of Judah
2 a Benjamite
3 an officer of David
4 a Levite

g.ad.ah.html:
זַבְדִּיאֵל n.pr.m. (my gift is God)—
1 father of one of David’s officers 1 Ch 27:2.
2 a prominent Hebrew in Nehemiah’s time Ne 11:14.

g.ad.ai.html:
זְבַדְיָהוּ, זְבַדְיָה n.pr.m. (י׳ hath bestowed)
1 Levites
2 an officer of Jehoshaphat
3 Benjamites
4 one of David’s men
5 an officer of David
6 a returning exile
7 one of priestly house

g.ae.aa.html:
זָבַח 134 vb. slaughter for sacrifice
Qal 112
I slaughter for sacrifice
II slaughter for eating
III slaughter for divine judgment
Pi. 22 sacrifice

g.ae.ab.html:
זֶ֫בַח 162 n.m. sacrifice
I general name for all sacrifices eaten at feasts
1 of the God of Israel
2 of other deities
II there are several kinds which are gradually distinguished
1 the covenant sacrifice, between Jacob and Laban
2 the passover
3 annual sacrifice
4 thank offering
5 in ritual of H & P
6 the slaughter of hostile nations
7 the verb used

g.ae.ad.html: מִזְבֵּחַ 401 n.m. altar

g.ae.af.html: זְבִינָא n.pr.m. (bought)—name of one who had taken a strange wife Ezr 10:43.

g.af.ac.html: זְבֻל n.pr.m. an officer of Abimelech

g.af.ad.html:
זְבוּלֻן, זְלֻבוּן n.pr.m. Zebulun
1 sixth son of Jacob and Leah
2 the tribe of Zebulun
3 territory of the tribe

g.af.ae.html: זְבוּלֹנִי adj.gent.; c. art. = n. coll. the Zebulonites

g.ag.aa.html: זוג, זיג (appar. √ of foll.; 𝔗 NH זוג, זיג is be clear, bright, transparent (ChWB Jastr 391a); others (so Thes) derive foll. from √ זגג with same meaning, v. infr. & Fl NHWB i. 560b).

g.ag.ab.html: זָג n.[m.] name of some comparatively insignif. product of vine: Nu 6:4

g.ah.aa.html:
זֶה demonstr.pron. and adv.; fem. זֹאת, once זֹאתָה; this, here
1 standing alone
2 In appos. to subst.
3 More oft. as pred.
4 It is attached enclitically, almost as an adv., to certain words, esp. interrog. pronouns, to impart, in a manner often not reproducible in Engl. idiom, directness and force, bringing the question or statement made into close relation with the speaker.
5 In poetry, as a relative pron. (rare)
6 With prefixes (in special senses)

g.aj.aa.html: זוֹ i.q. זֹה (q.v.): only Ho 7:16b this is their derision; and (as relat.) ψ 132:12 and my testimony which

g.ak.aa.html:
זוּ pron. (poet.), indeclinable.
1 a demonstr. this
2 a relative which

g.al.aa.html: זהב (√ of foll.; meaning dubious; cf. Lag BN 55 Anm).

g.al.ab.html:
זָהָב 385 n.m. gold
1 = gold-ore, gold in raw state
2 gold as wealth
3 gold as spoil of war
4 gold as merchandise
5 gold as costly gift
6 gold as material
7 gold described by its source
8 gold defined by var. adj. and pts.
9 as measure of weight and value
10 = golden oil, from colour
11 often named with
12 the chief vbs. used

g.am.aa.html: [זָהַם] vb. be foul, loathsome, but only Pi., causat.

g.am.ab.html: זָ֑הַם n.pr.m. (fr. above √ ?) a son of Rehoboam, 2 Ch 11:19.

g.an.aa.html:
[זָהַר] vb. be light, shining
Hiph. intrans. (late) send out light, shine

g.ao.aa.html:
[זָהַר] vb. only Hiph., Niph.
Hiph. instruct, teach, warn
Niph. be instructed, admonished, warned

g.ao.ab.html: זִו appar. n.pr. of 2nd month, = c. April-May, named as month of beginning the temple-building

g.ar.aa.html: זוה (√ of foll.; cf. Ar. Arabic put aside or away, draw together, contract).

g.ar.ac.html: [מָ֫זוּ] n.m. garner—only Pl. sf. ψ 144:13

g.as.aa.html: זוז (NH זוז move, As. zâzu, move, rise, come forth cf. COT gloss.; also be agitated, enraged, V R 64, i, 1. 11).

g.as.ab.html: זִיז n.m. coll. moving things (i.e. beasts)

g.as.ac.html:
זִיזָא n.pr.m.
1 a Simeonite
2 a son of Rehoboam

g.as.ad.html: זִיזָה n.pr.m. a Levite 1 Ch 23:11, = זִינָא v. 10

g.as.ae.html: זָזָא n.pr.m. a descendant of יְרַחְמְאֵל of Judah 1 Ch 2:33.

g.as.ag.html: יָזִיז n.pr.m. an officer of David 1 Ch 27:31.

g.at.aa.html: זוז (be abundant, cf. esp. As. zâzu, abundance, Dl Pr. 67f. Zim BP 94, 97; only as √ of foll.; perhaps related to I. זוז (cf. Thes), but this very dubious).

g.at.ab.html: זִיז n.[m.] abundance, fulness: only Is 66:11

g.at.ac.html: זוּזִים n.pr.gent. an ancient trans-Jordanic people, Gn 14:5

g.at.ad.html: זוֹחֵת n.pr.m. a descendant of Judah 1 Ch 4:20

g.au.aa.html: זול (prob. √ of foll., Ar. Arabic remove, depart).

g.au.ab.html: [זוּלָה] n.[f.] prop. removal, only found in st. c. as prep. and conj. except, only save that

g.av.aa.html: [זוּל] vb. lavish (be cheap, of little value, lightly esteem)

g.aw.aa.html:
[זוּן] vb. feed
Hoph. Je 5:8 well-fed horses, fig. of adulterers

g.ax.aa.html:
זוּעַ vb. tremble, quake
Qal tremble, quake
Pilp. causat. and intens. they that shall violently shake thee

g.ax.ab.html: זְוָעָה, and, by transpos., זַעֲוָה n.f. a trembling, i.e. object of trembling, terror

g.ax.ac.html: זִיעַ n.pr.m. a Gadite 1 Ch 5:13

g.ay.aa.html:
[זוּר] vb. be a stranger
Qal
1 Pf. become estranged
2 Pt. as adj. strange, or as noun stranger
Niph. Pf. be estranged
Hoph. Pt. estranged

g.az.aa.html: [זוּר, זִיר] vb. be loathsome, only 3 fs. Jb 19:17

g.az.ab.html: זָרָא n.[f.] loathsome thing, Nu 11:20 (J E)

g.ba.aa.html: [זוּר] vb. press down and out

g.ba.ab.html: זֵר n.m. circlet, border (orig. that which presses, binds)

g.ba.ac.html: זַרְזִיר adj. girded, girt—only cstr. Pr 30:31

g.ba.ad.html: מָזוֹר n.[m.] wound (as needing to have its matter pressed out)

g.bb.aa.html:
[זָחַח] vb. remove, displace
Niph. and that the breast-piece be not displaced etc.

g.bc.aa.html: [זָחַל] vb. shrink back, crawl away

g.bc.ab.html: זֹחֶ֫לֶת n.f. mng. dub.; perh. crawling thing, serpent—only c. art., in design. loc. 1 K 1:9

g.bd.aa.html: [זָחַל] vb. fear, be afraid—only Qal Jb 32:6

g.be.aa.html:
[זִיד, זוּד] vb. boil up, seethe, act proudly, presumptuously, rebelliously
Qal of Egyptians, in the matter as to which they acted presumptuously against them; of Babylon, against י׳ hath she acted presumptuously.
Hiph.
1 boil, seethe, trans.
2 act presumptuously, insolently

g.be.ad.html: [זֵידוֹן] adj. insolent, raging, only pl. and fig. ψ 124:5.

g.be.ae.html: נָזִיד n.[m.] thing sodden or boiled, pottage

g.be.aj.html:
זִיף n.pr.
1 n.pr.loc.
a city S.E. from Hebron
b city of southern Judah
2 n.pr.m. a son of יְהַלָּלְאֵל of Judah

g.be.ak.html: [זִיפִי] adj.gent.; only mpl. as n.pr.gent.

g.be.al.html: זִיפָה n.pr.m. a son of יְהַלֶּלְאֵל 1 Ch 4:16

g.be.ao.html:
זַ֫יִת n.m. olive-tree, olive
1 olive-tree
2 of fruit of olive-tree, olives
3 in designations of place

g.be.ap.html: זֵיתָן n.pr.m. (? olive-tree)—a Benjamite 1 Ch 7:10

g.bf.aa.html:
[זָכָה] vb. be clear, clean, pure, alw. in a moral sense
Qal
1 be clean, pure
2 be clear, be justified = be regarded as just, righteous, of God
Pi. make or keep clean, pure
Hithp. make yourselves clean

g.bg.aa.html:
[זָכַךְ] vb. be bright, clean, pure
Qal
1 be bright, shining
2 be clean, pure
Hiph. cleanse

g.bg.ab.html:
זַךְ adj. pure, clean
1 lit., pure, i.e. unmixed, free from foreign substances
2 fig., pure, clean, righteous

g.bg.ac.html: זְכוּכִית n.[f.] glass; as precious, yet of less value than wisdom Jb 28:17.

g.bg.ad.html: זַכַּי n.pr.m. head of a family of returned exiles

g.bh.aa.html:
זָכַר vb. remember
Qal
I Human subj.
1 remember, recall, call to mind, usu. as affecting present feeling, thought or action
2 remember persons (human subj.)
3 remember י׳
4 remember
5 think of or on, call to mind something present or future
6 remember a day, to observe, commemorate it
7 remember, with implied mention of, obj.
II Subj. י׳ (אלהִם)
1 remember persons
2
a remember the distress of his servants
b their devotion
3
a remember his own covenant (with them)
b his mercy
c extenuating circumstances
4 remember sins, idolatries
Niph.
1 be brought to remembrance, remembered, thought of, usu. c. neg.
2 neg. be not remembered = no longer exist, of name of Israel, as nation
3 be remembered, of particular days, in order to be observed, commemorated
Hiph.
1 cause to remember, remind
2 cause to be remembered, keep in remembrance
3 mention
4 record, only pt.
5 of sacrifice, make a memorial

g.bh.ab.html: [זֶ֫כֶר] n.pr.m. only 1 Ch 8:31

g.bh.ae.html:
זָכָר n.m. & adj. male
I subst. male, offspring of men and animals
II adj. sg. male (only human beings)

g.bh.ag.html:
זִכְרִי n.pr.m.
1 a Reubenite
2 a Judahite
3 Levites
4 a priest
5 Benjamites
6 father of a captain in Jehoiada’s time
7 mighty man of Ephraim

g.bh.ah.html:
זַכּוּר n.pr.m.
1 a Reubenite
2 a Simeonite
3 Levites
4 companion of Ezra
5 contemp. of Nehemiah

g.bh.aj.html:
זְכַרְיָהוּ, oftener זְכַרְיָה n.pr.m.
1 king of Isr., son of Jerob. II
2 father of Hezekiah’s mother
3 contemporary of Isaiah
4 a Reubenite
5 a Benjamite
6 a Manassite
7 a son of Jehoshaphat
8 a captain of Jehosh.
9 teacher of Uzziah
10 Levites
11 priests
12 returned exiles

g.bi.ab.html: יִזְלִיאָה n.pr.m. a Benjamite 1 Ch 8:18

g.bj.ab.html: מַזְלֵג n.m. appar. a sacrificial implement, three-pronged fork

g.bj.ac.html: [מִזְלָגָה] n.[f.] id. [g.bj.ab]—a sacrificial implement

g.bk.aa.html:
[זָלַל] vb. shake
Niph. shake, quake

g.bl.aa.html:

Qal
1 be worthless, insignificant
2 trans. make light of = be lavish with, squander
Hiph. make light of, despise

g.bl.ab.html: זֻלֻּת n.f. worthlessness, only ψ 12:9

g.bm.aa.html: זלעף (quadrilit. √ of foll.; v. reff. infr.)

g.bm.ab.html:
זַלְעָפָה n.f. raging heat
1 of fever heat of famine
2 of burning wind
3 fig. of zeal

g.bo.ab.html: [זָמָם] n.[m.] plan, device (bad sense), only ψ 140:9

g.bp.aa.html: [זָמַן] vb. only Pu. Pt. be fixed, appointed, of time

g.bq.aa.html: [זמר] vb. only Pi. make music in praise of God

g.bq.ab.html:
זִמְרָה n.f. melody, song, in praise of י׳
1 of instrumental music
2 of singing

g.bq.ae.html: מִזְמוֹר n.[m.] melody (techn. design. of psalms), always in this form; in 57 ψ-titles

g.br.aa.html:

Niph. be pruned

g.br.ab.html: זָמִיר n.[m.] trimming, pruning—only Ct 2:12

g.br.ae.html: [מְזַמֶּרֶת] n.f. snuffers, as utensil of Sol.’s temple

g.bs.ab.html: זִמְרָה n.f. of uncertain meaning, perh. choice products, of various fruits, etc. Gn 43:11

g.bs.ac.html: [זֶ֫מֶר] n.[m.] a certain animal allowed as food, most prob. some kind of mountain-sheep or -goat Dt 14:5.

g.bs.ad.html:
זִמְרִי n.pr.m.
1 a Simeonite
2 grandson of Judah
3 king of Isr. before Omri
4 a Benjamite

g.bs.ae.html: זִמְרִי n.pr.gent. vel patr., only Je 25:25

g.bs.af.html: זִמְרָן n.pr.m. son of Abraham & Keturah

g.bs.ag.html: זְמִירָה n.pr.m. a Benjamite, 1 Ch 7:8

g.bt.ab.html: זָנָב n.m. tail, also (fig.), end, stump

g.bt.ac.html: [זִנֵּב] vb. denom. Pi. cut off, or smite, the tail, only fig., of hostile attack in war

g.bu.aa.html:
זָנָה vb. commit fornication, be a harlot
Qal
1 be or act as a harlot
2 fig. of improper intercourse with foreign nations
3 of intercourse with other deities
4 of moral defection
Pu. fornication was not done (in going) after thee
Hiph.
1 cause to commit fornication
2 commit fornication

g.bu.ab.html:
זְנוּנִים n.[m.] fornication
a sexual
b international
c religious

g.bu.ac.html:
זְנוּת n.f.abstr. fornication
a sexual
b international
c religious

g.bv.aa.html:
זָנַח vb. reject, spurn
Qal reject
Hiph. (late) reject

g.bw.aa.html: [זָנַח] stink, emit stench;—only Hiph. Is 19:6

g.bw.ab.html:
זָנוֹחַ n.pr.loc.
1 Zanu‛a, SE. Ṣorea
2 a place in the mts.

g.bx.aa.html: [זָנַק] vb. only Pi. leap—Dt 33:22

g.bx.ad.html: זַעֲוָן n.pr.m. a descendant (branch or tribe) of Seir

g.bz.aa.html:
זָעַם vb. be indignant
[Qal]
1 be indignant, have indignation
2 express indignation in speech, denounce, curse
Niph. face stirred with indignation.

g.ca.ac.html: זָעֵף adj. out of humour, vexed, only of Ahab

g.cb.aa.html:
[זָעַק] vb. cry, cry out, call

1 call, to one's aid
2 cry, cry out, in need
Niph. be called together, assemble, join
Hiph.
1 call, call out, or together, for military service
2 make a crying
3 have proclamation made
4 call out, or at

g.cb.ab.html:
זְעָקָה n.f. cry, outcry
1 outcry, against
2 cry of distress
3 outcry, clamour

g.cc.aa.html: זער (Ar. Arabic be scanty, of hair, plumage, etc.; Aram. Syriac, זְעַר be or grow small; cf. צער).

g.cc.ab.html:
זְעֵיר n.[m.] a little (diminutive form)
1 of quantity, amount (of instruction)
2 of time

g.cc.ac.html: מִזְעָר n.[m.] a little, a trifle, a few

g.cc.ad.html: [זִפְרֹן] n.pr.loc. only Nu 34:9, place on northern boundary of Canaan

g.cd.ab.html: זָקָן n.m. and f. chin, beard

g.cd.ac.html:
זָקֵן vb. be or become old
Qal be (or become) old
Hiph. shew age, grow old

g.cd.ad.html:
זָקֵן adj. old
1 old, of human beings
2 usu. as subst.
a old man (or woman)
b elder

g.cd.ae.html: זֹ֫קֶן n.[m.] old age—Gn 48:10 (E).

g.cf.aa.html:

Qal Impf. 3 mpl.

Pu. refined

g.cg.ac.html: [אֲזֵק] n.[m.] id. [g.cg.ab], specif. manacle, only pl. manacles

g.ch.ac.html: זֶ֫רֶד n.pr.fl. identification disputed; between Moab & Edom

Pi.

Pu. be scattered

g.cj.ae.html:
זְרַחְיָה n.pr.m. (י׳ hath risen, or shined)

2 head of a family of returned exiles

g.cj.ag.html: אֶזְרָחִי adj.gent. i.e. of family of זֶרַח

g.cj.ah.html: יִזְרָ֑ח adj.gent. only in 1 Ch 27:8

g.cj.ai.html:
יִזְרַחְיָה n.pr.m. (י׳ will arise, or shine)
1 a man of Issachar
2 overseer of the singers

g.cj.aj.html: מִזְרָח n.[m.] place of sunrise, east

g.ck.aa.html:
[זָרַם] vb. pour forth in floods, flood away
Qal thou floodest them with rain, sweepest them (men) away.
Po. the cloud masses (Che) poured forth water.

g.ck.ab.html: זֶ֫רֶם n.m. flood of rain, rain-storm, downpour

g.ck.ac.html: זִרְמָה n.f. issue (of semen virile), in fig. of the paramours of Jerusalem Ez 23:20.

g.cl.aa.html:
זָרַע vb. sow, scatter seed
Qal
1 lit. sow
2 of shrub and tree producing, yielding seed
3 fig.
Niph. be sown, fructified
1 be sown
2 be fructified, made pregnant
Pu. of princes and judges under fig. of trees
Hiph.
1 produce seed
2 of a woman, = bear a child

g.cl.ab.html:
זֶ֫רַע n.m. sowing, seed, offspring
1 lit.:
a a sowing
b sowing as regularly recurring at its season
2 seed
3 seed = semen virile
4 seed = offspring
5 seed as marked by moral quality = persons (or community) of such a quality

g.cl.ad.html: [זֵרֹעַ] n.[m.] vegetable—only pl. Dn 1:12.

g.cl.ae.html: [זֵֽרְעֹן] n.[m.] id. [g.cl.ad], only pl. Dn 1:16.

g.cl.af.html:
יִזְרְעֶאל
1 n.pr.loc. (God soweth)
a city in the Negeb of Judah
b city in Issachar
2 n.pr.m.
a Hosea’s son
b Judahite name

g.cl.ah.html: [מִזְרָע] n.[m.] place of sowing, seed-land, only cstr. Is 19:7

g.cm.aa.html: זרע (cf. Ar. Arabic stretch out, extend, esp. arm or leg; Arabic power, Arabic forearm).

g.cm.ab.html:
זְרוֹעַ, זְרֹעַ n.f. and (rare) m. arm, shoulder, strength
1 arm
2 arm, as symbol of strength
3 Pl. forces, political and military
4 Shoulder of animal sacrificed, belonging to priest

g.cn.aa.html: [זָרַף] vb. prob. drip—Hiph. rd. in ψ 72:6

g.co.aa.html:
זָרַק vb. to toss or throw (in a volume), scatter abundantly
Qal
1 toss
2 intrans. grey hairs are profuse upon him
Pu. of water of purification poured over one defiled by a corpse

g.co.ab.html: מִזְרָק n.m. bowl, bason (prop. vessel for throwing or tossing a liquid)

g.cp.aa.html: [זָרַר] vb. only Po. sneeze; 2 K 4:35.

g.cp.ad.html: זַתּוּא n.pr.m. head of a family of returned exiles

g.cp.af.html: זֵתַר n.pr.m. an eunuch of Ahasuerus Est 1:10
